# 行舟 · 个人项目与事务中心 v0.3.0

这一版本重点改进“想到之后如何立即记下”和“复杂层级如何一眼看懂”。新增工作项窗口改用思源原生组件，全部页导航与层级标签也重新整理，同时降低误触完成操作的风险。

## 主要更新

- 页头提供全局“＋ 添加”入口，在全部、本周、收件箱和整理页都能直接以名称写入收件箱，并支持 `Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + I`。
- “长期领域与想法、顶层项目、独立事务”三个侧栏分区提供紧凑的 `＋`，可直接创建适合该分区的工作项。
- 可从长期领域或项目详情及思源原生右键菜单添加下级，自动带入直接父项与可推导的顶层项目。
- 新增窗口改用思源原生 `Dialog`，移除高 GPU 占用的实时背景模糊，并跟随思源主题与窗口行为。
- “添加顶层项目”明确区分层级角色与数据库类型：顶层项目和子项目都存为“项目”，由直接上层关系确定实际角色。
- 全部页按“长期领域与想法、顶层项目、独立事务”分区；全部筛选完整展开层级，活跃项目筛选只显示活跃路径中的执行事项。
- 层级图例、中间树和右侧详情共用彩色文字角色标签，统一显示长期领域、顶层项目、子项目、任务、事务和想法。
- 在当前领域或项目内新增下级后保持原视图，只展开并选中新条目，不再强制跳到直接父项目。
- 完成操作移至角色标签行并改名为“标记为完成”，使用柔和绿色次级样式；完成后提供 8 秒撤销入口。

## 数据与兼容性

- 思源属性视图仍是唯一工作项数据源，插件不维护第二份数据。
- 本版本不要求迁移或重建数据库，也不会自动创建、删除或重命名字段。
- 顶层项目与子项目仍共用“项目”类型；行舟根据直接上层关系推导其界面角色。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Projects & Tasks v0.3.0

This release focuses on capturing new work immediately and making complex hierarchies understandable at a glance. Creation now uses native SiYuan dialogs, All-page navigation and hierarchy labels are clearer, and completion is safer against accidental clicks.

## Highlights

- Added a global “+ Add” action across All, Week, Inbox, and Review, with `Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + I` support for name-only Inbox capture.
- Added compact `+` actions to Areas & Ideas, Top-level Projects, and Independent Transactions for correctly prefilled creation.
- Added contextual child creation from area/project details and native SiYuan context menus, prefilling the direct parent and derived top project.
- Replaced the custom creation overlay with SiYuan's native `Dialog`, removing GPU-heavy live backdrop blur and inheriting native theme and window behavior.
- Clarified that top-level projects and subprojects share the Project database type; their actual role is derived from the direct-parent relationship.
- Reorganized All-page navigation into Areas & Ideas, Top-level Projects, and Independent Transactions. All expands the full hierarchy, while Active Projects follows active paths to executable items.
- Unified colored text role badges across the hierarchy legend, middle tree, and detail pane for areas, top-level projects, subprojects, tasks, transactions, and ideas.
- Kept the current area or project scope after creating a descendant inside it, selecting and expanding the new item without a forced navigation jump.
- Moved completion into the role row as a soft green “Mark as completed” action and added an eight-second Undo window.

## Data and compatibility

- The native SiYuan Attribute View remains the only work-item data source; Xingzhou stores no duplicate database.
- This release requires no database migration or rebuild and never creates, removes, or renames fields automatically.
- Top-level projects and subprojects still share the Project type; Xingzhou derives their UI role from direct-parent relations.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
